methodology.neighbourhoodDisclosure: Asking prices from sale listings, not completed transactions. The CSV does not state a property-type filter. Price range is the publisher's 25th–75th percentile. Listing counts indicate source records, not verified unique homes.
methodology.pointDisclosure: Neighbourhood anchors are OpenStreetMap place labels. They locate a label on the map; they are not neighbourhood boundary polygons.
methodology.unitDisclosure: Administrative-unit colour and figures are the published Q2 2026 Keydata averages as reported by Hyrja. They are a separate metric and source; never merge them with Prona neighbourhood medians.
methodology.geometrySnapshot: OpenStreetMap Geofabrik Albania extract, downloaded 2026-10-27; ODbL attribution applies.
methodology.fallbackPolicy: No fallback price is silently substituted. Where a neighbourhood estimate is absent, show the nearest broader benchmark separately and identify its publisher, period, and metric.
